knownBiases: Arrival time is substituted with source event time because archival delivery time is unavailable.
Multiple VIIRS platforms remain one instrument family and are not treated as independent modalities.

unmeasured: negative-case precision outside the governed incident corpus
ambiguous-to-correctly-abstained rate without authoritative pixel identity labels

reasons: No negative opportunity-control corpus is present, so false-incident rate is not measurable.
The real historical corpus covers one region and one season; multi-region and cross-season generalization are not established.
VIIRS platform diversity is not independent physical-modality diversity.

limitations: This evaluation does not claim ignition-time ground truth.
The current live US activation is recorded separately and is not promoted to a historical test label.
